info.name: DT-MIS Salesforce project push
info.description:
# DT-MIS project push

Requests for testing the endpoint that receives projects from Salesforce.

## Set up
1. Open the collection, then the Variables tab.
2. Paste the secret key from the DT-MIS endpoint document into the **push_secret** current value. Leave base_url as it is unless DT-MIS tells you otherwise.
3. Run the requests in order, or use Run collection. Each request signs itself, so there is nothing else to configure.

## How signing works
The collection pre-request script computes HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp, a full stop and the exact body, and sends it in X-DT-Timestamp and X-DT-Signature. The same steps apply in Apex; see section 3 of the endpoint document.

## Test data
Every sample project is named "TEST - Postman sample project, please ignore". Requests 1 and 2 create or update those projects in DT-MIS, so tell DT-MIS before running them against the live server.

exec: // Signs the request: HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + body), as described in the DT-MIS push document.
throw new Error('Set the push_secret collection variable first (Collection > Variables).');
